sections.title: Charanam 1
lyrics: shrIdamA! nAthO vAdamA? - nE bhEdamA? idhi mOdamA? rAma!
All below charanam’s similar to Charanam 1
Charanam 2 - shrIramA hRcchAramA! brAvabhAramA? rAyabhAramA? rAma!
Charanam 3 - viNTini nammukoNtini - sharaNaNtini rammaNtini rAma!
Charanam 4 - Odanu bhakthi vIdanu - orulavOdanu nIvAdanu rAma!
Charanam 5 - kammani viDEmimmani - varamukommani paluku rammani rAma!
Charanam 6 - nyAyamA? nIkAdAyamA? intha hEyamA? muni gEyama rAma!
Charanam 7 - chUdumi kApAdumi - mammu podimiga koodumi rAma!
Charanam 8 - kshEmamu divya dhAmamu - nithyanEmamu rAma nAmamu rAma!
Charanam 9 - vEgarA karuNāsAgarA - shrIthyAgarAjuni hRdhayAgAra rAma!
